page.layout: One page of running text in one column, headed by the running title and page number at the top. No marginal notes, no notes below the text. Ends with a catchword at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: Figura est elocutio, qua orationis habitus à vul-gari consuetudine cum quadam suavitate muta-tur: Die zierliche gestalt ist eine rede zierung/damit der rede eigentliche form vom gemeinen brauch mit einer lieblichkeit verändert wird.
Duplices: Vocum & Sententiarum. Figurae vocum sunt novem: Epizeuxis, Anadiplosis, Climax, Anaphora, Epistrophe, Symploce, Epanalepsis, Parono-masia, Polyptoton.
Epizeuxis, die widerholung einer stim / est figura, in qua idem sonus continuè iteratur: ut, Et respondens dixit illi Dominus, Martha, Martha, sollicita es, & turbaris erga plurima. Lucae 10.
Et hora nona exclamavit Jesus voce magna dicens: Eloi, Eloi, lamma sabachthani? quod est interpretatu, Deus meus, Deus meus, ut qd dereliquisti me? Mar.15.
Anadiplosis, die zweyfaltigung / est figura, in qua idem sonus in fine praecedentis & principio sequen-tis sententiæ iteratur: ut, Hic tamen vivit: vivit? imò vero etiam in senatum venit, Cicero.

*Climax, die aufsteigung / est figura, in qua oratio per gradus ita progreditur, ut antecedens sequenti loco repetatur: ut, Sed & gloriamur in tribulationi-bus, scientes quod tribulatio patientiam operatur, patientia autem probationem, probatio verò spem. Spes autem non confundit. Roman.5.

page.notes: Long s is printed as plain s throughout. Black letter German is marked with bl. The asterisk before "Climax" is a printed mark, kept as is. "sabachthani" is read with the long s rule (scan looks like "fabachthani"). "me9" and "qd" are printed abbreviations; the mark after "me" is unclear. The final catchword "cipiis" completes the word "prin-cipiis" begun at the end of the page.
